The low-level atmospheric disturbance in the vicinity of Sri Lanka is likely to develop into a low-
pressure area around the next 48 hours. Therefore, wind speed can increase over the sea areas
around the island during the coming days.
The naval and fishing communities are requested to be attentive to the future forecasts and bulletins
issued by the Department of Meteorology in this regard.
Showers or thundershowers will occur at several places in the sea areas around the island.
Winds will be South-westerly or variable in direction. Wind speed will be (20-30) kmph.

The sea areas around the island can be Slight to moderate.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.
